title: CBE Monetary Policy Committee Raises Interest Rates by 100 Basis Points
content: The Monetary Policy Committee of the Central Bank of Egypt decided to raise the overnight deposit rate, overnight lending rate, and the rate of the main operation by 100 basis points to 28.25%, 29.25%, and 28.75%, respectively. The discount rate was also raised by 100 basis points to 28.75%.

labels.notes: Tier 1 source, critical category, MPC decision

title: FRA Approves New Consumer Finance Regulation for Digital Lenders
content: The Financial Regulatory Authority has issued new regulations governing digital consumer lending platforms in Egypt. The new rules require all BNPL and digital credit providers to obtain FRA licensing and maintain minimum capital requirements of EGP 50 million.

labels.notes: Tier 1 source, regulatory change affecting Forsa's market

title: valU Raises $150 Million in Series C Funding Round
content: Egyptian BNPL company valU, a subsidiary of EFG Hermes, has closed a $150 million Series C funding round led by a consortium of regional and international investors. The company plans to use the proceeds to expand its merchant network and launch new financial products.

labels.notes: Direct P1 competitor major funding event

title: Egypt's Inflation Rate Drops to 24.5% in August 2026
content: Egypt's annual urban inflation rate fell to 24.5% in August 2026, down from 26.3% in July, according to data released by CAPMAS. Core inflation also declined to 22.8%. The CBE targets inflation in the 5-9% range over the medium term.

labels.notes: Economic indicator relevant to consumer finance sector

title: MNT-Halan Partners with Visa for Digital Payment Integration
content: MNT-Halan, Egypt's leading digital lending platform, announced a strategic partnership with Visa to integrate digital payment capabilities across its lending and BNPL products. The partnership will allow Halan users to make payments at any Visa-accepting merchant.

title: Opinion: Why Egypt's BNPL Bubble Will Burst in 2027
content: In my opinion, the Egyptian BNPL market is overheated. I predict that by 2027, we will see major consolidation. Companies like valU and Halan are overvalued. This is not financial advice.

title: Egypt Hosts International Tourism Fair in Sharm El Sheikh
